   MINUTES OF THE REGULAR MEETING
  NORWALK COMMUNITY PROMOTION COMMISSION
  JANUARY 13, 2025

Chair Leon called the meeting to order at 6:00 p.m. Responding to roll call were Vice Chair Ang and
Commissioner Sanchez. Also present was Levy Sun, Director of Communications & Public Affairs and
Alex Ocegueda, Office Assistant III.

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

Chair Leon made the motion and Commissioner Sanchez seconded to approve the minutes for
December 16, 2024. There being no objection, the motion carried.

REPORTS

Holiday Home and Business Décor Contest

Mrs. Ocegueda reported that the contest winner recognitions may be moved to a different council
meeting date. Commissioners discussed possibly making changes to the contest timelines, eliminating
the winner lawn signs, creating “participant” lawn signs, and having staff deliver certificates to the
winners instead of presenting them at a City Council meeting.

Home and Business Beautification Contest

Mrs. Ocegueda discussed the timeline of hosting the contest period to be in the month of March.
Commissioners will judge participants at their April 14th meeting via power point slides. Awarding of
the winners at a City Council meeting is tentatively scheduled for May. Commissioners agreed to the
timeline.

Business Spotlight

Ms. Ocegueda reported no new video was produced and that the January business spotlight is in
process.

Communications and Public Affairs Analytics

Mr. Sun provided the analytics and explained Key Performance Indicators (KPI) and the city’s overall
reach across all outreach platforms for the last month showing an increase in key metrics.

STAFF COMMENTS:

Mrs. Ocegueda asked Commissioners to start considering themes for the Meet & Greet Dinner and the
possible party favors they wish staff to investigate. After much discussion about starting City
merchandising, Commissioners voted to have Communications run a survey to determine what
residents would want to purchase.
 Minutes of the Regular Meeting
Community Promotion Commission
January 13, 2025

COMMISSIONERS COMMENTS:

Chair Leon commended the city on its website during the false evacuation notices. Chair Leon also
reported the Primestor is willing to provide giveaways to the Commission. Ms. Ocegueda confirmed
that the Easter event, March 29, 2025, is the next event that the Commission will staff. Commissioner
Sanchez commended the 605 All Star Band on their performance at the Rose Parade. Vice Chair Ang
reported his participation in the Rose Parade and reported the common sighting of people supporting
the 605 All Star Band. He voiced his wish that there is a continuation of the band in some way.

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

Christopher Guerrero, a Norwalk resident, informed the Commission that merchandise is best if
targeted to Gen Z populations. Christopher also clarified direct-to-garment prints can get intricate if
needed. He also mentioned that the design must tell the story that people can resonate. He mentioned
as a business owner; he emphasized the need for proper marketing that target the right audiences.

ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting was adjourned at 7:44 p.m.

_____________________________

Armida Leon, Chair
Community Promotion Commission
